entries.title: Job 33:1
segments: However, Job, please hear my speeches, and listen to all my words.

entries.title: Job 33:2
segments: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue has spoken in my mouth,

entries.title: Job 33:3
segments: my words [shall be] from my upright heart, and my lips will clearly speak knowledge.

entries.title: Job 33:4
segments: The Spirit of God made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

entries.title: Job 33:5
segments: If you can, answer me; set yourself in order before me, stand up.

entries.title: Job 33:6
segments: Behold, I [am] toward God even as you [are]; I also am formed out of the clay.

entries.title: Job 33:7
segments: Behold, my terror shall not make you afraid, and my burden shall not be heavy on you.

entries.title: Job 33:8
segments: Surely you have spoken in my ears, and I have heard the sound of [your] words.

entries.title: Job 33:9
segments: [You said], I [am] pure, without transgression; I [am] innocent, and no iniquity [is] in me;

entries.title: Job 33:10
segments: behold, He finds reasons to be against me, He counts me for His enemy;

entries.title: Job 33:11
segments: He puts my feet in the stocks; He marks all my paths.

entries.title: Job 33:12
segments: Behold, [in] this you are not right; I will answer you, for God is greater than man.

entries.title: Job 33:13
segments: Why do you fight against Him? For He does not give account for [any] of His matters.

entries.title: Job 33:14
segments: For God speaks once, yea, twice, [but] not one takes notice.

entries.title: Job 33:15
segments: In a dream, a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men; while [they] slumber on the bed;

entries.title: Job 33:16
segments: then He opens the ear of men and seals their teaching,

entries.title: Job 33:17
segments: so that He may turn man [from his] act, that He might hide pride from man.

entries.title: Job 33:18
segments: He keeps back his soul from the Pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

entries.title: Job 33:19
segments: He is also chastened with pain on his bed, and enduring strife [in] his bones;

entries.title: Job 33:20
segments: so that his life is sick of bread, and his soul desirable food.

entries.title: Job 33:21
segments: His flesh wastes away, not seen; and his bones laid bare; they were not seen.

entries.title: Job 33:22
segments: Yea, his soul draws near to the Pit, and his life to the dealers of death.

entries.title: Job 33:23
segments: If there is a messenger for him, a mediator, one among a thousand, to declare for man his uprightness,

entries.title: Job 33:24
segments: then He is gracious to him and says, Deliver him from going down to the Pit; for I have found a ransom.

entries.title: Job 33:25
segments: His flesh shall be fresher than in vigor; he shall return to the days of his youth;

entries.title: Job 33:26
segments: he shall pray to God, and He will be gracious to Him; and he shall see His face with joy, for He will restore to man his righteousness.

entries.title: Job 33:27
segments: He will observe to men, and say, I have sinned and perverted righteousness; and it was not equally repaid to me,

entries.title: Job 33:28
segments: He has redeemed my soul from passing over into the Pit, and my life shall see the light.

entries.title: Job 33:29
segments: Lo, all these [things] God does two or three times with a man,

entries.title: Job 33:30
segments: to bring back his soul from the Pit, to be lighted with the light of the living.

entries.title: Job 33:31
segments: Hear this, Job, listen to me; be silent and I will speak.

entries.title: Job 33:32
segments: If you have anything to say, answer me; speak, for I desire to justify you.

entries.title: Job 33:33
segments: If not, listen to me; be silent, and I will teach you wisdom.
